title: Understanding Deep Learning
institution: The MIT Press (print edition, 2023); free PDF and notebooks from the author via udlbook.github.io and github.com/udlbook/udlbook
description: Deep-learning textbook in 21 chapters (1 Introduction; 2 Supervised learning; 3 Shallow neural networks; 4 Deep neural networks; 5 Loss functions; 6 Fitting models; 7 Gradients and initialization; 8 Measuring performance; 9 Regularization; 10 Convolutional networks; 11 Residual networks; 12 Transformers; 13 Graph neural networks; 14 Unsupervised learning; 15 Generative adversarial networks; 16 Normalizing flows; 17 Variational autoencoders; 18 Diffusion models; 19 Reinforcement learning; 20 Why does deep learning work?; 21 Deep learning and ethics) with appendices A Notation, B Mathematics and C Probability. The book site lists 68 Python notebook exercises 'with missing code to fill in based on the text' (none for chapter 14), and its source links an answer booklet, errata, interactive figures and a video-lecture playlist.
codeLicence: Notebooks/ folder: file 'LICENSE (MIT)', 'Copyright 2023 Simon Prince', standard MIT permission text (read 2026-10-31). The repository root LICENSE is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

Inquiries regarding rights should be addressed to the MIT Press, Rights & Permissions Department. This work is subject to a Creative Commons CC-BY-NC-ND license.' Alternate page footers repeat 'This work is subject to a Creative Commons CC-BY-NC-ND license. (C) MIT Press.'
Repository root LICENSE: 'Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International Public License' (full legal code).

NoDerivatives: Corniversity may copy the PDF for private non-commercial study and cite it, but must not share adapted versions of the book's text or figures; lessons and summaries are Corniversity's own words.
The notebooks are separately MIT-licensed (see codeLicence); completed notebook exercises remain private study work.
No restriction on machine processing or AI use was seen on the title page, the repository LICENSE or the notebook licence.

The PDF prints no ISBN; 9780262048644 comes from the MIT Press link on the book site. Both MIT Press pages tried returned HTTP 403 and were not read.
The PDF's licence line names 'CC-BY-NC-ND' without a version; the repository LICENSE is version 4.0.
Chapters were checked at their opening pages only. The answer booklet, errata, slides, interactive figures and video lectures were not opened; one notebook was opened and none was run.
The PDF is about 22 MB and is served from release-assets.githubusercontent.com after a redirect from github.com.

The importer does not follow redirects, so an import from the github.com release link stops at the redirect and stores nothing; read the PDF in the browser, or upload a copy through the library within its size limit.
